# Detentions: Dipke, Rathee and others (collected 2026-11-13)

Machine-readable twin: `data/story/detentions.json` (status: draft). Every snippet below is verbatim from the fetched page text (curl, browser User-Agent); `verified:true` in the JSON means a script found it in that text. Claimant and status are given per row.

## Bottom line for the "high-handedness" beat

- **Dhruv Rathee WAS detained** (not merely stopped or served notice): taken from his family home in Sector 56, Gurugram, early on Saturday 10 Oct 2026, held, and released overnight. Reported by PTI, IANS and others; a police officer confirmed the release to PTI. Clock time is disputed (about 6 am to about 8 am, see table). He was NOT detained at an airport.
- **Dipke, Das and Ranka WERE detained inside the plane on landing** (10 Oct). The only clock time is "around 10.30 am" (Oneindia, single source); other outlets say "minutes after" landing. So this is mid-morning, not early morning.
- **Dipke detained at home** on 16 Oct (20+ police at the door, notice served earlier): documented, but no source gives a clock time, and the context points to afternoon or evening. Do not call it early morning.
- The only documented pre-dawn or early-morning home detention in the sources read is Rathee's.

## Others

- **Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka:** detained with Dipke on the plane, 10 Oct (documented, same sourcing). Police sources: Ranka taken to Dwarka. A 27 Sep Guwahati detention of Ranka appears in search results; the ThePrint page was blocked, so it is not recorded.
- **Neha Bora (AISA):** detained at Mandi House on 16 Oct shortly after Dipke; released 17 Oct under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act. Evening, not early morning.
- Opposition figures (Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee, Pinarayi Vijayan) were detained on 10 Oct per Al Jazeera and Oneindia; the Kejriwal report says he was detained near Jantar Mantar after setting out from Lodhi Estate. No dawn or airport detention found; not recorded as events.

## NOT supported

- Rathee detained at an airport or "as soon as a plane landed": no. That applies to Dipke, Das and Ranka only.
- Dipke detained "early in the morning at home": no. His home detention (16 Oct) has no clock time and fell in the afternoon or evening.
- Dipke "detained" on 20 Jul: retracted by CJP after Delhi Police denial.
- Rathee arrested by Noida Police: denied.
- Rathee's "beaten", "kidnapped", "22 to 23 hours": his own claims, no police response read.
